definitions.gloss: perforation; line of small holes for tearing
definitions.explanation: A row of small holes or cuts in paper or packaging that allows a section to be torn off cleanly. Common on envelopes, receipts, stamps, tickets, and forms.

examples.japanese: ミシン{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{切|き}り{取|と}って→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
ミシン{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}せます→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧。
examples.english: Because there are perforations, you can easily tear it off by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ミシン{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}して→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tear this entry postcard along the perforations and send it.

notes:
⟦ミシン→ミシン：06365_mishin⟧ comes from ⟦ミシン→ミシン：06365_mishin⟧ (sewing machine, from English 'machine'), as the line of small holes resembles stitch holes made by a sewing machine needle. The ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ component means hole or eye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミシン{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the perforations
- ミシン{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧: to tear off along the perforation
- ミシン{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to perforate
